'''Enhanced Premiere''' is the 24th expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 1 November 2000. The set consists of 21 premium cards.

The 21 new premium cards of '''Enhanced Premiere''' introduce dual Personnel cards, combo dilemmas, Mission II cards with outposts, and built-in speed up rules - like playing two cards per turn instead of one. Unlike previous Enhanced products, this set is specifically designed to be playable in Sealed Deck events - a new format called '''Warp Speed'''. Key advantages are smaller deck sizes, shorter spacelines, a much faster seed phase, and streamlined gameplay. There are built-in speed-up rules such as playing two cards per turn instead of one and "evening up" a hand to seven cards each turn, and a handful of rules designed to make it easy to use the random cards in Premiere packs.

There are six different packages produced. Each package has 4 packs of white-bordered [[Premiere Unlimited '95]] expansion and 5 new premium cards. There are a total of 21 new premium cards: 12 are fixed and 9 are randomized. The premium cards all have the theme of "two cards in one." Each 5-card premium set include 1 Dual-Personnel, 2 Mission and 2 Combo Dilemma cards. The featured cards are Dual-Personnel cards with 2 "bridge crew" characters from The Next Generation. Each package has a die-cut window revealing the dual Personnel card. There are 12 packs per display box, 2 of each design.

This set is noted for the following:
*Several cards included images from the PC game '''Star Trek: Armada'''
*Introduced Combo Dilemma cards
*Introduced dual sided Mission II cards

==Additional Information==
*'''Enhanced Premiere''' was printed on 121 card sheets by Teagle & Little, USA.
*The print sheet had 4 copies of cards 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 15, 16, 17, 18, 20, 21 and 8 copies of cards 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 19 for a total of 120 cards. Included on the print sheet was 1 copy of the rare Black Test Card to complete the 121 card print sheet (11x11 format).
